name: Jewelry
overview: Scripture shows that jewelry, such as earrings, bracelets, and rings, was commonly used in biblical times both as personal adornment and as gifts, as seen in the accounts of Rebekah receiving golden earrings and bracelets (Genesis 24:22, 53). Jewelry also served as offerings to the Lord, highlighting its value and significance in worship (Exodus 35:22; Numbers 31:50). However, God’s instructions emphasize clear distinctions in behavior and appearance, particularly regarding gender roles and bodily markings, forbidding practices like wearing garments of the opposite sex or making marks on the body (Deuteronomy 22:5; Leviticus 19:28), which underscores the importance of honoring God through modesty and order in outward adornment.
